"Nine Million Bicycles" is a song written and produced by Mike Batt
for the singer Katie Melua's second album, Piece by Piece.
As a singer, Batt's solo albums included Schizophonia[11][12] and Tarot Suite[13][14] (1979, Epic Records) (both with the London Symphony Orchestra).
From mikebatt.com, the album list appears to include: Schizophonia, Tarot Suite, Waves, Six Days In Berlin, Zero Zero, Songs Of Love And War, Arabesque.
